conflicts.description: The skybridges are failing and the islands are beginning to drift, but renewing them requires cooperation among enclaves that distrust one another.
conflicts.title: The Fading Bridges

conflicts.description: The Windguild demands free passage on the Heartspan while the Concord insists on tolls to fund repairs, threatening a blockade.
conflicts.title: Dispute over the Heartspan

conflicts.description: The Rootwardens demand that the Silver Lens share the lost renewal rites, but the Order fears the knowledge will be misused.
conflicts.title: The Hoarded Knowledge

description: Aeloria is a fractured fantasy realm of floating islands, each hovering in the luminous sky above a sea of silver cloud. For a thousand years the isles have been held in a gentle orbit by the ancient skybridges, luminous spans of woven starstone and living light that carry travelers, trade, and the mysterious currents that keep the islands aloft. Now the bridges are failing, one quiet fracture at a time, and the archipelago has begun to drift apart. A young cartographer named in the tales of the Skybridge Chronicles discovers the pattern in her maps and must persuade four rival enclaves to set aside old grudges and mend the spans before the isles scatter beyond reach. The tone is wondrous and hopeful, full of shimmering vistas, lyrical place names, and the courage of the young, while still carrying real stakes of loss, mistrust, and the fragility of connection.

factions.description: Cartographers and surveyors of Lumeria who chart the drift of every island and keep the records of the skybridges.
factions.name: Concord of Mapmakers

factions.description: A proud guild of traders and glider pilots who depend on the skybridges for commerce and resent Lumerian control of the Heartspan.
factions.name: Veloran Windguild

factions.description: Forest keepers who believe the bridges are living things and distrust the machinery and measuring of outsiders.
factions.name: Rootwardens of Ondara

factions.description: Secretive scholars of Serathae who hoard knowledge of how the skybridges were woven and how they might be renewed.
factions.name: Order of the Silver Lens

history.description: The first keepers of all four enclaves joined voices to weave the original skybridges, binding the isles into one archipelago.
history.title: The Weaving of the Spans

history.description: Veloria and Lumeria clashed over the Heartspan tolls, ending shared keeper rites and beginning centuries of mistrust.
history.title: The Toll Quarrel

history.description: The Order of the Silver Lens withdrew its teachings from the other enclaves, and the knowledge of renewing the skybridges faded from common memory.
history.title: The Silence of Serathae

history.description: A hairline crack of dark light appeared in the Heartspan, noticed first by a young cartographer comparing her maps against the sky.
history.title: The First Fracture

locations.description: The central island and seat of the Mapmakers' Concord, ringed by terraces of glass lanterns. Its great skybridge anchor, the Heartspan, links to every other enclave and is where the first fractures appear.
locations.name: Lumeria

locations.description: A windswept island of orchards and sail-gliders, home to proud aerial traders. Its long skybridge to Lumeria shimmers with trade caravans and is slowly dimming.
locations.name: Veloria

locations.description: A misty island of deep forests and singing waterfalls that pour into the clouds below. Its guardians tend the ancient roots that anchor one end of the western skybridge.
locations.name: Ondara

locations.description: A high, crystalline island of observatories and silver towers, home to scholars who study the light within the skybridges and guard secrets about how they were first woven.
locations.name: Serathae

name: Aeloria of the Drifting Isles

rules.statement: Each skybridge emits a binding current that keeps its two anchored islands in a stable orbit; when a skybridge fails, those islands begin to drift.
Skybridge light is sustained by a resonant harmony that requires attuned keepers from at least two enclaves working together.
No explosive powders or firearms exist in Aeloria; conflict is fought with glider raids, blockades, and the closing of skybridge gates.
Every enclave may close its skybridge gate to others, and by custom travelers must pay a toll or offer a service to cross.
Charts drawn with starstone ink record true positions and slowly change as the islands drift, making cartographers the first to notice distant change.
